name: earshot
description: Screen reader companion for Claude Code: detects VoiceOver, NVDA or JAWS, enables screen reader mode from the next start, delivers whole answers, narrates tool activity, and adds the /a11y-on, /a11y-off, /a11y-status, /a11y-stream, /a11y-last, /a11y-tools, /a11y-heartbeat and /a11y-log commands.
displayName: Earshot: screen reader companion for Claude Code
